# truenas_vm_stop (Action)

Stops a VM (vm.stop). No-op when the VM is already stopped, so it is safe to trigger repeatedly — e.g. before each truenas_vm_device is destroyed.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) ID of the VM to stop (truenas_vm.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Power the VM off immediately instead of requesting a graceful shutdown (vm.stop's force option).
- `force_after_timeout` (Boolean) Force the VM off if it has not shut down gracefully within the timeout (vm.stop's force_after_timeout option).
